Independence is explicit in this calculated example. Repeated cumulative
tests on overlapping samples have a different dependence structure; their
exact error, its strict excess over the nominal level and its limit one
are proved in \cref{thm:p15-w02b-p15-061-finite-error,thm:p15-w02b-p15-061-unbounded}.
